description: This file contains a mock implementation of a plugin test store for the Focalboard server, including user, team, channel, and license management functions used in integration testing.

classes.name: PluginTestStore
classes.description: A mock store for testing plugin functionalities, managing users, teams, channels, and licenses.

methods.name: NewPluginTestStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new instance of PluginTestStore with predefined users and teams.

methods.name: GetTeam
methods.description: Retrieve a team by its ID.

methods.name: GetTeamsForUser
methods.description: Retrieve all teams associated with a specific user.

methods.name: GetUserByID
methods.description: Retrieve a user by their ID.

methods.name: GetUsersList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of users by their IDs.

methods.name: GetUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieve a user by their email address.

methods.name: GetUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieve a user by their username.

methods.name: GetUserPreferences
methods.description: Retrieve preferences for a specific user.

methods.name: GetUsersByTeam
methods.description: Retrieve users belonging to a specific team.

methods.name: SearchUsersByTeam
methods.description: Search for users within a team based on a search query.

methods.name: CanSeeUser
methods.description: Determine if one user can see another based on guest status and shared board membership.

methods.name: SearchUserChannels
methods.description: Search for channels associated with a user in a team.

methods.name: GetChannel
methods.description: Retrieve a channel by its ID within a team.

methods.name: SearchBoardsForUser
methods.description: Search for boards accessible to a user, filtered by team membership.

methods.name: GetLicense
methods.description: Retrieve or generate a license object, with optional compliance feature based on environment variable.
